brief:
A security source in the Radee force said the unit assisted families fleeing a camp controlled by "client gangs" operating in the Yellow Zone north of Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The official did not specify how many families were involved or provide details about their current whereabouts following the exodus.

The security source issued a public call for remaining families still trapped inside the encampment to evacuate immediately. He gave no explanation for the timing of the mass departure or the conditions that prompted residents to flee the armed group's compound in the northern sector of the territory.
